newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Union makes 15 pct pay claim on BHP.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Union makes 15 pct pay claim on BHP.

text.p: The Australian Workers' Union (AWU) said on Tuesday it proposed to make a claim for a 15 percent wage rise over two years against the steel division of Australia's biggest company, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd.

The proposal, agreed to by senior AWU officials at a meeting about three weeks ago, would be outlined over the next fortnight to around 12,000 AWU members working at BHP steelworks around the country, AWU Victoria state secretary Bob Smith said.
The claim comes as the AWU and BHP are due to enter talks for the renegotiation of their enterprise bargaining agreement, which expires on January 1, Smith told Reuters.
The claim does not include any new productivity offsets and is based on a cost-of-living adjustment and BHP Steel's relative profitability.
